verdict.rationale: Warp documents a broad first-party REST API with SDKs. It covers HR, payroll, time off, workplace and department data, and has write endpoints such as creating benefit deductions, custom field definitions and managing the offer lifecycle. Nothing states that the API matches the UI, and the pricing page says the advanced API module is Enterprise-only, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that payroll runs, contractor payments, onboarding and settings are fully exposed via the API, parity on base plans rather than only Enterprise, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Warp API lets you build custom apps and integrations that use your company's HR, payroll, time off, workplace, and department data.
Create and send offers, list existing offers, and manage their lifecycle.
Create Benefit Deduction: Create a benefit deduction for a worker.
Enterprise unlocks the advanced API module for production workflows.
